workflow: Hand-authored HTML / CSS / SVG reference compositions rendered locally by Playwright Chromium (scripts/jurnl/f09-territory-proof-render.mjs). Format WIREFRAME_PLUS_BRAND_RENDER. Brand fonts and palette from the repository; all imagery is procedural SVG (plaster, travertine, linen, olive, liner). No legacy plate, photograph or screen crop was used.
why_this_workflow: OpenArt is out of scope for this sprint. A deterministic local render is reproducible from source, costs nothing, keeps imagery separable for the blur test (every decorative layer carries data-imagery), and binds every figure to real breakdown fields in code.

reasons: Draft 1: unfilled template tokens broke the chrome and nav; the plan read as a framed box, not a room (no paving, weak walls)
Balance pass: wall-course contrast raised; olive moved off the dimension line to the right outer frame
Final check: the olive sat mostly off-canvas and its two leaf tips read as arrow glyphs (UI-like). It was redrawn as a full small sprig in the gap beside the right wall.
Balance pass: reading line moved up to the sentence (empty mid-stage gap); after-clause 31→32px; perimeter shade +25% opacity
Draft 1: the flap liner hid behind the slip; the state stamp collided with CLEAR TO SPEND; the linen weave read as graph paper
Balance pass: the composition shifted down 20–26px to centre the object stage

evidence_rerenders.reason: The first board was blank: page.setContent cannot load file:// images. Fixed by embedding the candidates as data URIs.

The first removal pass used visibility:hidden on SVG roots, and Chromium still painted their filtered children, so 'removed' equalled the authority. Fixed with display:none and verified by pixel difference (mean abs diff 3.1 / 6.3 / 5.6).
